messages:
jess: FYI - proposing a small header 'x-rd-ratebound' to carry per-tenant rate bound + window. Will bake into routing policy. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/ratebound-proposal (draft)

mike: link looks fine. Is this meant to be advisory (SDK honor) or authoritative (server rejects)?

jess: advisory + server-enforced fallback. SDKs should surface backpressure hooks and optional queued/retry modes.

tara: this is going to touch python/ts/go clients. I worry about breaking sync APIs if we add blocking waits. Can we do opt-in?

olivia: +1 opt-in. Devex can expose a callback for 'on_ratebound' that returns 'drop|queue|throttle' — default queue with small jitter.

mike: for async clients ok; sync libs: we could expose a non-blocking flag that raises RateBoundError so callers can decide.

ryan: re: console, need telemetry keys to show ratebound events per-route. We'll add 'ratebound.events' metric. Also need example dashboards and alert thresholds.

jess: good. rollout plan: 1) headers accepted server-side (no SDK change) 2) SDK opt-in API next week 3) enable console dashboards/alerts then enable server enforcement 2w later.

olivia: proposal for Python API:

```py
# opt-in
client = Redwood(api_key=..., ratebound_mode='callback')
client.on_ratebound = lambda info: 'queue'  # or 'drop' or raise
```

mike: TS similar shape? 

```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey, ratebound: {mode: 'callback', onRateBound: (info)=> 'throttle'} })
```

tara: Go SDK harder — goroutines and blocking semantics. Suggest: return error type RateBoundError with RetryAfter to encourage backoff instead of internal blocking.

olivia: agree. We'll doc migration guide. Also add a feature flag to opt-in per-release.

ci-bot: ✅ Integration test run passed for header parsing on dev.

deploy-bot: deploy to staging at 1729990300 finished :rocket: 

mike: For telemetry, we need a sampled trace id on the header so we can correlate traces without PII. Maybe include ratebound_id token.

jess: keep header small. ratebound-id ok. We'll add 'rbid' field compressed base62.

olivia: ok I'll draft SDK PRs for py/ts/go and link by EOD.

mike: noted. If anyone has objections to 'callback' naming, speak now. Otherwise we'll proceed.

tara: no objection. prefer 'on_ratebound' naming.

jess: thanks team — proceeding with rollout plan. :tada:
